subject.title: normalizeGitHubActor: not idempotent — strips only one trailing [bot]

question: Should repeated trailing `[bot]` suffixes be collapsed for requester grouping while mutation authorization continues to compare the submitted actor without this normalization?
rationale: The helper fix is mechanically small, but deciding where the normalized identity may be consumed defines a mutation-authorization boundary that automation should not broaden implicitly.

options.title: Keep normalization grouping-only
options.body: Approve repeated-suffix collapsing only for requester grouping and require focused tests that raw malformed identities remain unauthorized.

options.title: Preserve single-suffix behavior
options.body: Reject the idempotence change if maintainers want malformed repeated suffixes to remain observably distinct throughout actor processing.

recommendation.title: Keep normalization grouping-only
recommendation.body: Approve repeated-suffix collapsing only for requester grouping and require focused tests that raw malformed identities remain unauthorized.

likelyOwner.reason: They explicitly requested deliberate review of this exact actor-normalization and mutation-authorization boundary.
